::: proof

For entry $(i,j)$, where row $i$ indexes the denominator $\vcoef$
(see @def-vector-valued-derivative)
and column $j$ indexes the numerator $\matr{A}\vcoef$:

$$
\ba
\left[\deriv{\vcoef} (\matr{A}\vcoef)\right]_{ij}
&= \deriv{\coef{i}} (\matr{A}\vcoef)_j \\
&= \deriv{\coef{i}} \sumto{k}{p} a_{jk} \coef{k} \\
&= a_{ji} \\
&= \left[\tp{\matr{A}}\right]_{ij}
\ea
$$

:::
